items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: And I left his band to go with P. Sean's band.

ctx.x: And I left his band to go with P. Sean's band. That was a little six-piece band he had then.

Anything else about this band that P. Ron had? I remember I was up in Missouri, I think 1936 and 1937 along there. I remember seeing that boat advertisement that they advertised, the P. Ron band. And I didn't get...
You didn't get a chance to see it.
